species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 56°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 18–38 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 65 ft, cold below.

species.name: Crappie
why: Water 56°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.

The lake is layered: warm water down to about 65 ft, cold below.
